evidence: PR #726 (feat/wow-capability-launcher-20260831) failed policy-gate with 'user-facing PR requires completed product acceptance' -- its description has no Product acceptance section at all. PR #725 failed the same gate first with '2 acceptance checkbox(es) unchecked' before being fixed and rerun.
impact: User-facing PRs from the overnight wow-campaign are being opened without the policy-required product-acceptance section filled in. Costs a CI round trip and investigation time per PR; hit twice out of 9 open PRs this session.
promotion_reason: single non-critical observation; collect another occurrence
suggested_change: Add a local pre-push check, or a PR template with the Product acceptance section pre-filled with unchecked boxes, so a user-facing PR cannot be opened without the section present.
summary: User-facing PRs are opened without the required product-acceptance section, so the first CI signal is a generic policy-gate failure instead of the real gap.
verified_by: read policy-gate job logs for PR #725 and #726 (mcp__github__get_job_logs), confirmed exact failure text
